title: Cross-agent review handoff (implementer -> reviewer)
description: Opened at session start and appended to during the work, not assembled at the end. The reviewer spawns cold, so this payload is the entire contract between the two agents.

round.description: 1-based round number within one cross-check loop.

session.description: Opaque session identifier. Adopters that capture LLM wire traffic should reuse the capture session id here so a review joins its own transcript.

scope.description: Every repository this change touches. The reviewer reads diffs by reference from these SHAs; the payload never inlines them.

clearance_required.description: Opaque clearance token. Adopter policy defines the vocabulary and the ordering; this contract only requires that one exists. Computed as the maximum over scope[].clearance.

claims.description: The load-bearing field. A claim with no way to falsify it is not a claim.

headline_numbers.description: Named summary figures the reviewer should re-derive rather than accept.

traps.description: Tooling gotchas learned during the work that the reviewer would otherwise fall into. Append at the moment of discovery; these are the entries reconstruction-at-the-end reliably loses.

attack_first.description: Ranked. The author's own guess at where this change is weakest.

self_flagged.description: Judgment calls the author is knowingly taking, offered for challenge rather than buried.

out_of_scope.description: Pre-existing breakage not chargeable to this change. Every entry is challengeable by the reviewer.

artifacts.description: Paths the reviewer may read. Offered as evidence, not as tools: the reviewer should not reuse the author's scripts to check the author's work.

ground_rules.description: Constraints on how the reviewer may act, e.g. read-only, do not start stopped services, verify content rather than status.

disposition_ref.description: Path to round N-1 disposition. Null on round 1. Round N+1 is a delta against this, not a restatement.

coverage.description: Computed by set arithmetic over the diff, never asserted by the author.

check_results.description: Filled by the harness before the reviewer is spawned, so the reviewer never re-runs a passing mechanical claim.

prompt_sha256.description: Hash of the rendered reviewer prompt. Does not make an LLM reproducible; makes a disagreement diagnosable.

model.description: The serving model. Provider is not vendor: one harness can serve several vendors' models.

policy_key.description: Adopter routing key this path resolves to.

dirty.description: True when the working tree has uncommitted changes, which head_sha does not describe.

expected.description: Human-readable expectation. Never a substitute for `check`.

files.description: Paths this claim covers. Drives the coverage computation; an empty list means the claim covers nothing.

then.description: A mechanical claim IS a test. Prose that cannot be executed never gets executed.

budget.description: Over budget blocks until the author trims. Silent truncation would drop exactly the traps and attack_first entries that make the review worth running.

output_ref.description: Path to captured output. The payload carries the pointer, not the bytes.

model_vendor.description: Vendor of the serving model. A diversity claim against a model you cannot name is not a claim.

availability_checked.description: Availability probing makes selection environment-dependent; record whether it ran.
